objectives: worst safety miss rate (max over workloads, 90% upper bound)

recommended.name: lowest_energy
recommended.why: Lowest predicted energy per robot-hour (mean over S1, S2, S3, S6) among designs whose 90% upper bounds keep every safety task under 0.5% misses and T4/T2 under 5% misses (zero expected misses in the window) on every workload.

recommended.name: smallest_area
recommended.why: Smallest area proxy whose 90% upper bounds pass the same deadline limits.

recommended.name: balanced
recommended.why: Knee of the feasible frontier: minimum of normalized energy plus normalized area.

caveats: VX-1 is fictional; the area proxy is rough.
Feasibility uses the surrogate's 90% marginal upper bounds; the guarantee is marginal, so each recommendation is re-run with the full model.
Runs are 1.2 simulated seconds (verification also at 4.8 s); rare events longer than that are not sampled.
